rationale: Axium's current portfolio page presents Axium Aster & Axium Bloom together as one active manager-level social-infrastructure investment comprising two legal portfolios, 26 facilities and 4,114 beds in Alberta and British Columbia. Axium owns 92.5% of each portfolio and AgeCare owns the 7.5% balance and operates the facilities. The existing AgeCare Facilities Portfolio record already contains the Aster and Bloom identity and the same primary manager source, so it is corrected in place rather than duplicated. Its Ontario 16-home / 2,418-bed scale belongs to separately presented Axium Iris and is removed for a later delta-sweep task. The proposal preserves separate Aster and Bloom vehicles and entry histories, removes the unsupported generic Axium Managed Funds / AxInfra Fund I-IV attribution, records AgeCare as current minority co-owner and Revera as the former western-portfolio co-owner, and finds no Axium exit or signed pending sale through August 18, 2026. Axium's 2022 ESG report identifies Aster with AIC II, but no matching production Fund row exists; this proposal therefore does not invent or create a fund relation and records the disclosure for later fund-data review.

afterImage.name: Axium Aster & Axium Bloom
afterImage.description: Axium Aster & Axium Bloom is Axium Infrastructure's combined manager-level investment in two Canadian long-term-care property portfolios. Axium's current portfolio materials report 26 operating facilities and 4,114 beds across Alberta and British Columbia, with cash flows supported by provincially licensed, regulated and funded long-term-care and continuing-care frameworks plus resident co-payments. Axium owns 92.5% of each portfolio; AgeCare owns the 7.5% balance and operates the facilities. Aster began in 2020 as a five-facility, 1,402-bed Alberta partnership at 80% Axium and 20% AgeCare. Bloom traces to the western tranche of the Revera-Axium joint venture that first closed in 2017; Revera sold its remaining 15% interest in certain Alberta and British Columbia homes to AgeCare in 2022. Individual homes are underlying assets, and the separately presented 16-home Ontario Axium Iris portfolio is outside this company boundary. No Axium exit or signed pending sale was identified through August 18, 2026.
